Mod version: configurableextramobdrops_1.16.5-1.8.jar

## **Question**
Hey, so I've been trying to add custom loot to enemies with your mod and I've ran into a problem.

Short version: Lootbox items won't drop as intended, even when they are visible in a mob's hand before death.

Long version: Trying to make a zombie apocalypse themed modpack, using craftingdead's lootboxes. They are container items that when spawned in creative mode are a block that you place then right click to open and a random item from a specific list pops out. When added either via ingame console or config file with this mod, they seem to automatically open and equip the zombie with whatever it is yet only clothing items will drop on death (which isn't normal armor, it has a different equipment menu, so it probably doesn't equip to them?). Whereas guns/tools/medicines/ammo and even things like parachutes just refuse to drop (which are not equipped via the armor's menu, but are normal items). The only alternative I can think of is to add another mod, and making them drop some simple currency like an emerald instead of the lootboxes and using vending machines as a laundering service to get the lootboxes.. Practically the same outcome, stacking better as a plus, but the themed lootboxes (civilian/police/army etc) would be wasted. And 3/5 of the box types would be mostly pointless if you can just choose the best 2.

Any ideas on how to get these lootboxes to drop, preferably as they spawn in creative as that stacks much easier than pre-opened? Thanks!
-Sui

issues.title: Ideas for Hand Over Your Items mod
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Hand Over Your Items


## **Feature description**
There are a couple things in the config that might make it easier not to accidentally use this feature.  One thing would be to have the minimum and maximum distance from player to player configurable.  Often when we are building we are also sneaking so if someone comes too close to us next thing you know they are grabbing up on our items by accident.  It gives the goldilocks zone so to speak if you have a certain range on things.  The next idea is having the ability to toggle a confirmation of some sort when triggering the function.  In a similar way, if it verifies you actually want to give items it can help avoid accidental transfer to some extent.  Given that confirmations are kind of annoying under some circumstances to some people it prompted me to say it would be good to be able to toggle it on and off.  Another potential control would be to allow for turning the ability to hand over items on and off completely.  Given how many things use keybinds maybe it might be good to have the option to toggle the ability through a command potentially but maybe optionally through a keybind (maybe if you can have a prefix like ctrl+(g as default) or something if that makes sense.  Anyways great work, keep it up!

issues.title: TNT only breaks bedrock if it breaks a block above it
issues.body:
## **Information**
Minecraft version: 1.18.2
Modloader: Fabric
Fabric loader version: 0.14.8
Environment: Singleplayer

Mod name: TNT Breaks Bedrock (Fabric)
Mod version: 2.2


## **Description**
TNT can't break bedrock on its own, but instead only breaks bedrock by breaking a block above the block of bedrock. That is, when TNT destroys a block, a block of bedrock directly beneath the destroyed block will also be deleted.

EDIT: After some more testing, this description isn't entirely accurate. I can't figure out what's actually going on, but this described method does seem to be the only way to *reliably* break bedrock.

issues.title: Use WeakHashMaps in CollectiveEvents
issues.body:
While fixing an AE2 issue related to collective, I came across the two hash maps in CollectiveEvents.
See:
https://github.com/ricksouth/serilum-mc-mods/blob/76f9ced01759b5d1296c5c8105f2aa212801e562/sources/Collective/src/main/java/com/natamus/collective/events/CollectiveEvents.java#L51

This is bad. Since the world unload event isn't used to clean up, collective will keep levels alive *forever* while the game is still running. This can add up if people hop between their single player worlds.

Potential Fix: Use WeakHashMap, allowing Java to clean up the keys.

issues.title: Set World Spawn Doesn't Affect Bonus Chest
issues.body: As the title states, if you use this mod to change your worlds spawn location and create a new world with a bonus chest, the bonus chest will not be created at the modded world spawn point.  This is, to me, a bug, not a feature request, since if you're moving the world spawn, then the bonus chest should be moved as well.  This also makes me worried that the 'always loaded world spawn chunks' will also not be affected by this mod, and I very much do want my carefully chosen world spawn location to always be loaded just like the normal world spawn is.  Having the modded location always loaded instead of the normal one would be even better, just to avoid the waste of system resources on always loading the normal world spawn as well as the modded one.

Hi, love your mods. Just wondering if the default chances of giants spawning or bred rabbits being killer is 0 on purpose. The mod page says that the default chances should be 0.05, but in the freshly-generated config files the chances are just 0. Is it being set to an integer by accident?

issues.title: Consider allowing non-Curseforge modpacks to use your mods with links back to your Curseforge pages?
issues.body:
I've been fine-tuning a modpack that uses a lot of mods that aren't on Curseforge, as well as mods that are on it. I've really enjoyed a lot of your mods in the past, and while looking to add some of yours to the modpack, I noticed your mod pages state that they can only be used in a modpack that's hosted on Curseforge. Since I'm using mods and resourcepacks not available on Curseforge, and intend to distribute the modpack as a simple install (freely, no ads), this means I can't use any of your mods in it, which is a bummer.

I hope you reconsider this policy, as I would really like to use your mods in the modpack, which is solely for improving Minecraft experience and not to be monetized in any way. 

In the meantime I've been looking for replacement mods that implement the same features that your mods do, since you currently do not give permission to distribute them outside of the Curseforge ecosystem. I've found a few, but I don't like having to do this, because I do like your mods a lot and would like to share them with others.

Anyway, thank you for creating the mods in the first place. I've especially enjoyed the configurable compass/clock GUIs, and Compact Help Command.

## **Feature description**
A background for the clock like the Coordinates overlay in Bedrock Edition, and adjustable opacity would be an added bonus.

issues.title: Backport to 1.12.2
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Full Brightness Toggle (Forge)


## **Feature description**
I know 1.12.2 isn't a "maintained version" anymore despite there being quite a few mods still being updated for it, but being able to enable and disable pseudo-night vision on command is really nice to have no matter the version, especially since there aren't any mods that add such a simple thing for a standalone mod which is mildly upsetting to me.

I wouldn't imagine this being difficult to do since setting the game's gamma value really high up probably does the same thing for *almost* every version.

issues.title: Configurable delay for Advancement Screenshot
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Advancement Screenshot

## **Feature description**
The `cooldown` value in the following code should be configurable. This should allow the mod to be compatible with Advancement Plaques or other mods that make the client take more than 20 ticks (1 second) to fully show the advancement on screen.
https://github.com/ricksouth/serilum-mc-mods/blob/1cf87f06e08dd6904fd420256c01d65006fcac31/sources/Advancement%20Screenshot/src/main/java/com/natamus/advancementscreenshot/util/Util.java#L21-L24

Ideally, this should be configurable per advancement tier (Task, Goal, Challenge) since Advancement Plaques has the same per-tier configuration for the fade-in, fade-out, and total time.

issues.title: Exploit: You can have infinite air with only one bottle
issues.body:
Minecraft version: 1.16.5.
Modloader: Forge
Forge version: doesn't really matter
Environment: Singleplayer

Mod name: Bottled Air
Mod version: 1.0



When you use an empty bottle underwater, it replenishes your air and turns into a water bottle. But you can then drink the water from the bottle and have your empty bottle back. This way, a single bottle is enough to stay underwater forever.

I see two solutions to this problem.
1) Make drinking water from bottles impossible underwater
2) Make it, so that when you drink water underwater, it takes away the same amount of air you got from the empty bottle

I think, the first option is better, as it is more intuitive, but the second one is still a valid choice.

issues.title: More Sponge Types For Extra Sponges
issues.body:
Bigger Sponge Absorption Radius is a very convenient mod in that it allows you to keep all your sponges together in one easy to collect pile, but it doesn't reduce the number of sponges needed (I don't think?!?  Please forgive me if I'm wrong about this!!!).  [Extra Sponges](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/extra-sponges) makes sponges upgrade-able so that each individual sponge does absorb more water (as well as adding a Lava sponge!!!), so the ultimate option would be to be able to combine these two effects!

Now, I know you're going to have at least a few problems with this suggestion:
1. This could be very difficult from a technical standpoint, but I don't think it will be!  One simple solution is to just add instead of multiply.  So say a normal sponge provides X absorption radius (which would be Tier 0).  A Tier 1 sponge would have an X+1 (or 2?!?) absorption radius.  Then, your recursive function, rather than just counting sponges and doing the "default sponge radius * neighbouring sponge block count" function at the end, checks the sponge type and adds it's personal absorption radius to a running total that is returned at the of the recursion.  Alternatively you could just only allow sponges of the same type to work together and have a "tiered sponge radius * neighbouring sponge block count" that only counts sponges of the same type as the last one placed, but I don't think that would be any easier, I'd only do it if I felt that was better/more balanced from a game perspective.
2. You're  all about 'vanilla' Minecraft, no new items, just new mechanics.  But this could be a "this mod supports additional sponge types" thing without adding them in this mod!
3. This mod is Forge, that one is Fabric.  This I think is less of an issue since you always provide all your mods in both Forge and Fabric (for which I GREATLY thank you, you're awesome, please do keep it up!!!).  I would ask that you at least make a Forge Extra Sponges (and you might want to make a Fabric one two, depending upon how you do the cross-mod interactions between 'Bigger' and 'Extra', as well as to ensure that there always is a Fabric one, in case the original author is unable to continue for whatever reason).

issues.title: [Beautified Chat] Add compatibility with Quark's Item Sharing Feature
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Beautified Chat [Client]


## **Feature description**
I've noticed that with Beautified Chat installed I am unable to see when my friends share their enchanted items and such using Quark's Item Sharing feature where basically a player can put an item in the chat and others are able to view an items enchants or contents (in the case of shulkers and backpacks). Basically what happens is that they share an item and the only thing I am able to see is the name of the item. The item is supposed to show up with a colored name in the chat and when you hover over the name it shows the enchants of the item or the contents.

I was wondering if it was possible to add compatibility with Quark's Item Sharing so that even with Beautified Chat I can see the enchants/contents of whatever item my friends are showing off, as ever since I installed the mod I refuse to take it off lol it's just such a good aesthetic compared to the vanilla chat.

issues.title: Set World Spawn Point and Starter Kit not triggering
issues.body:
## **Information**
Minecraft version: 1.18.1
Modloader: Fabric
Fabric loader version: 0.13.2
Environment: Multiplayer

Mod name: Set World Spawn Point
Mod version: 1.8

Mod name: Starter Kit
Mod version: 3.1

## **Description**
Neither mod does anything.  I have used the command to set the spawn point ingame, and it said it worked, but the config file in the server did not change.  I manually set the co-ordinates in the config file and new players do spawn around that location but not exactly, though _forceExactSpawn is set to true.  I have tried repeatedly by deleting a test player's data from the server and spawning them again, but same result each time.

New players also do not get the starter kit equipment set in the config file, which did set correctly when I ran that command.

Not sure whether a separate ticket for each is needed, but possibly related due to the set spawn not working and thereby not triggering the starter kit.


## **Crash report**
No crash.

issues.title: Collective breaks Botania's Corporea Index
issues.body:
## **Information**
Minecraft version: 1.18.1
Modloader: Fabric
Fabric loader version: 0.46.1+1.18
Environment: Singleplayer

Mod name: Collective
Mod version: 3.14
Tested with the modpack [Benchmark II](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/benchmark-ii) and with a minimal setup.

## **Description**
Installing Collective (without any dependent mods!) with Botania (with dependencies Trinkets and Patchouli) will break the Corporea Index from Botania grabbing chat messages from nearby players, preventing them from being able to request items with chat messages.

This seems to be caused by this mixin:
https://github.com/ricksouth/serilum-mc-mods/blob/8e88a8888e24422e5e28c9d37596c3dd1418473e/sources-fabric/Collective%20(Fabric)/src/main/java/com/natamus/collective_fabric/fabric/mixin/ServerGamePacketListenerImplMixin.java#L43-L45
The event handler is provided with one component, but then the mixin compares the identity of the returned one with a different one, which means it always goes into its own handling.

I suspect that Beautified Chat Server will also break our functionality (consider moving this to use ModifyVariable, perhaps?), but Collective is a library mod so it probably shouldn't break much out of the box.

Originally reported as:
- https://github.com/VazkiiMods/Botania/issues/3927
- https://github.com/Chuunkyz/BenchmarkII-1.18/issues/51

## **Crash report**
N/A

issues.title: "Naturally Charged Creepers" Should Increase Lightning Strikes On Creepers
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Naturally Charged Creepers


## **Feature description**
While this mod is great for making charged Creepers more common, and even possible underground, I don't feel that the mod truly lives up to it's name, **Naturally** Charged Creepers.  Since the idea of this mod is to "increase the game's difficulty", then why not make it that whenever it rains, there's a chance for a naturally spawning creeper (on the surface) to get hit by lightning, and during thunderstorms most/all naturally spawning creepers get hit!

issues.title: Some (Minor) Needed Improvements to Infinite Trading...
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Infinite Trading


## **Feature description**
Could we have a few more config options for this mod?  I'd really like to see:

-Disable regular Villager infinite trading (honestly, why isn't it this way, instead of having the option to disable Wandering Traders, when the latter isn't always available and Villager are?  To Be Clear, I don't want to replace the option to disable Wandering Trader infinite trades, I want this option added in addition to that currently existing one).
-Change infinite Villager trades to "Select the number of trades you want", so instead of being forced to choose between the vanilla trade limit and no limit, you can set whatever trade limit you want, with 0 being the vanilla trade limit, and -1 being infinite trades.
-Change infinite Wandering Trader trades to  "Select the number of trades you want" (same as previous).
-Change number of times Villagers reset trades (as an alternative to more trades at once).
-Change number of times Wandering Trader resets trades (rather than zero, the vanilla standard.  Might be more tricky, maybe his llamas count as his job site block?)
-Wandering Trader changes trades on reset (so he doesn't just reset his current trades, but provides all new ones, which would make the previous option all the more valuable and useful).

I guess at this point the mod would need to be renamed from "Infinite Trading" to something else, like "Greatly Improved Trading"!  Though if so, you should definitely include that other idea to allow one to trade all they have of an item with a single click: https://github.com/ricksouth/serilum-mc-mods/issues/571

issues.title: Campfire Spawning In Other Dimensions Is Too Big A Cheat!
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Campfire Spawn and Tweaks


## **Feature description**
I like the Campfire Spawn and Tweaks mod because I like to take a bed with me whenever I'm out exploring so that I can sleep the night away.  This, of course, destroys my base bed spawn, which has forced me to either always build my main base at world spawn, or at least have an outpost there with a quick travel option back to my main base.  This mod could completely fix that entire issue!

However, this mod is just a bit TOO powerful, in my opinion.  After all, vanilla nether respawn anchors exist, and  I think that they should be respected a bit more.  All I ask for is for config options to:

-Disable campfire spawning in any dimension except the Overworld (which already has infinite free respawning with beds, so this really isn't that different or unbalanced).
-Blacklist to disable campfire spawning in specific dimensions (like the nether 😜).
-Require Soul campfire for spawning in the nether.  Or maybe another override list that specifies what fuel the campfire has to be built with to act as a respawn anchor in that dimension instead of the normal campfire.  This would just be a new campfire recipe, not a new campfire (though if you could specify a new flame color, that would be AWESOME).
-Require some form of charging/cost-to-respawn like the vanilla respawn anchor.  Better yet, make it dimentions specific, with config list specifying what fuel that you have to right click the campfire with to 'refuel' it for more respawning in that dimension (perhaps by using some native block to that dimension—sticks, nether bricks, and purpur blocks? Maybe flint for modded dimensions so you don't have to provide a per mod support, though you could include an API to let other mods register a flint alternative).  This 'fuel' item could even be displayed on the normal food cooking spots on the campfire (hey, presto, simple charge count already built in 😜).

I know my "charging campfire spawns" idea would be complicated and costly to implement, but while I do want to make Minecraft more convenient, I don't want it to be so easy it's no longer challenging/fun, and I doubt I'm the only Vanilla Tweaks user who feels that way!  And, so long as you enable the first three disabling config options, the final two "charging campfire spawns" options can wait!

issues.body:
## **Information**
Minecraft version: 1.16.5
Modloader: Forge
Forge version: 36.2.20 
Environment: Multiplayer

Mod name: Hand Over Your Items
Mod version: 1.4


## **Description**
On Multiplayer, using the Create Above And Beyond modpack (with a few extra mods such as this one added for convienience and QoL features), I've noticed a consistent issue when using this mod to give items to my partner. Shift+Right Clicking on her with an item that has right click functionality will give it to her serverside, but perform the functionality clientside which causes issues until they re-sync.

Things that have occured:

-Used a Lava Bucket while pointing roughly at the ground, partner recieved the (full) bucket, but on the clientside a block of non-flowing lava appeared with clientside light until another light update happened, which was unable to burn me but did slow me down. Placed a block on the fake lava to delete it.

-Used an EXP-Storing item from another mod, which on Shift+Right Click is supposed to retrieve 1 level of EXP from the item. Tried to give it to my partner, she recieved the item (without it having lost any stored EXP), while on my client's end, I recieved the 1 level, which I then used to try to enchant on an anvil since it gave me enough to do it (9 levels). The item was enchanted but then instantly reverted to the unenchanted state and the enchanted book dropped to the ground when I exited the inventory. All my levels seemed to be gone until I gained experience again at which point they reverted to the correct number (8 levels).

issues.title: Request: Certain feature parity with Compass Ribbon mod
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: GUI Compass (Fabric Version)


## **Feature description**
I'm currently using this mod with the [Compass Ribbon](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/compass-ribbon) mod. They both already work flawlessly together, but it would be cool if some additional options were available in this mod for customisation to match the features of it.

There are 3 points I wanted to raise with you (a bug, a toggle, and a feature request):

1.  In testing, I noticed a bug: this mod doesn't activate when a compass is in the offhand slot. 

2. I'm using this mod for the coordinates, and the other for the directions, so could there be an option to only display the coordinates? (option in the settings to remove the direction facing letters)

3. In addition to the visibility options that your mod features (to be always visible, or only activate when a compass is in the player's inventory), Compass Ribbon has the option to display when the compass is only on the players hotbar/offhand, or only in the players hand/offhand. Could these options be implemented into yours too?

Thank you for this mod by the way! These issues would be a nice-to-have, rather than a necessity, so no stress if you don't have time to implement them 😊

issues.title: DisFabric functionality issue with Collective
issues.body:
## **Information**
Minecraft version: 1.18, 1.18.1
Modloader: Fabric
Fabric loader version: 0.12.8, 0.12.11, 0.12.12
Environment: Multiplayer

Mod name: Collective
Mod version: 3.13, 3.14


## **Description**
When Collective is running alongside discord bridge mod DisFabric [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/disfabric](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/disfabric), DisFabric will not send any player chat text from the server to the discord, though everything else works (discord to server chat, and join/quit/death/advancement messages).
Confirmed working properly when Collective is removed. Not caused by any of the other Serilum mods as this was also tested without them.
DisFabric does not work in singleplayer so was unable to test with that.
EDIT Dec. 16: Tried and failed with 3.14

Fabric API version 0.44.0
DisFabric version 1.3.5

issues.title: Will it cut down my custom tree?
issues.body:
I am currently making a custom tree, heavily based off this one https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_qCN1eX2iE4&t=626s&ab_channel=GlitchNOut
I am wondering if i build this tree, and i am destroying something with an axe e.g. a crafting table inside the tree, if i accidently harvest one wooden block will it destroy my whole tree? I have currently put many hours into this project and will be heartbroken if it just disappears in a flash. Also, if it would destroy the tree, i would be very grateful if i could change a setting that would make it not destroy the tree.

Many Thanks, Daniel.

issues.title: Infernal Paintings get included in painting cycle pool
issues.body:
Minecraft version: 1.16.5
Modloader: Forge
Forge version: 36.2.4
Environment: Tested in singleplayer, but my modpack is intended for both singleplayer and multiplayer play

Mod name: Cycle Paintings (Forge) and Infernal Expansion
Mod version: 2.0 and 2.4.0, respectively

The Infernal Painting is a separate item from vanilla Paintings, crafted with 4 blaze rods, 4 sticks, and wool. I wanted to exclude these paintings and the item from my modpack, since I feel like the artwork doesn't fit a vanilla Minecraft style, and they look out of place next to the other paintings that are available. I can simply remove the crafting recipe via CraftTweaker, but unfortunately using Cycle Paintings still allows you to turn a regular painting into an Infernal Painting simply by right-clicking on it enough times.
In the meantime I suppose I can just use a resource pack to change the Infernal Painting's textures to be the same as some vanilla ones, but I hope that someday I can fully remove these paintings from my modpack entirely.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Listing other blocks that count as campfires, and producing other effects from them optionally via configs.
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: healing campfires

## **Feature description**
I'd like to request the ability to have other campfires be  manually registered in the configs. Such as the different colored campfires from mods such oh the biomes you'll go, or better end forge for example.

Also the ability to specify different combinations of blocks which campfires can be placed on to produce effects in an area. For example placing a soul campfire on glowstone to make mobs in the area glow.

something of a list like:

["minecraft:soul_campfire;minecraft:glowstone;minecraft:glowing-60-0"]
So item id of campfire object, semi-colon, object to be placed on, semi-colon, potion effect to radiate, dash, duration in ticks, dash, amplifier. 

if you want something to apply another effect, you can define the same thing again, but change the effect and that campfire will now radiate two effects. If you miss the second item id and the effects out it will assume to use the base haybale and regeneration effect using the block you defined first.

For example, a regenerating campfire is pretty strong. But I have corail tombstones which has an effect which makes mobs automatically target from immediately which can be placed on the player to make it more risky to do when not in a safe location for example by just defining the normal campfire and haybale combination and adding tombstone:bait with a duration to it.

Alternatively this would open it open to be more than a simple rest point, as the player could definite these as basically radiating zones for effects. Like the soul campfire on glowstone one would be quite good as an early warning system to pick up on people or mobs coming into a defensive perimeter perhaps.

Whether or not you'd be able to force the signalling effect from the campfire or generate other custom effects from the campfire object itself would be up to you however.

aaaaaalternatively, you can open it up to datapacking perhaps, and have people do a json for each object they want to radiate effects and on what block and a radius and stuff. however you want to do it really.

issues.title: Incompatibility with Systemzee's giant mod
issues.body:
I needed a way for giants from Systemzee's giant mod (see https://mods.syszee.com/) to spawn naturally, so I ended up using this mod. It worked fine and the giants spawned perfectly.

However, the problem is that one of the boss giant's attacks summons more zombies, and every time this happens, 1 out of the group spawns as a giant. This new giant is also able to do the same attack, which summons another giant, so on and so forth, and given how they have a ton of health, it's not easy to get rid of an infinitely replicating giant.

If there is a way to get around this by adding a config for allowing the player to change what mob it replaces instead of zombies, it would be much appreciated.

issues.title: The advancement checker for Advancement Screenshot is not very robust and fails in some cases.
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Advancement Screenshot
Mod version: 9c376dd1be8ce7c287692f42ae5e991dd0c6f026

## **Description**
https://github.com/ricksouth/serilum-mc-mods/blob/9c376dd1be8ce7c287692f42ae5e991dd0c6f026/sources/Advancement%20Screenshot/src/main/java/com/natamus/advancementscreenshot/events/AdvancementGetEvent.java#L69-L78

The above code presents the following problems:
1. You can take an Advancement Screenshot without gaining an advancement if you send a chat message that contains the following text (replace `Player` with your in-game name): "Player has reached the goal ["
2. If your language is not English, no advancement screenshots are taken, as the non-English translation does not match the pattern expected by the above code.
3. Completing a challenge does not result in an Advancement Screenshot being automatically taken, as the code only checks for the message gained from completing a regular advancement or a goal advancement.
4. If `/gamerule announceAdvancements` is false, no advancement screenshot is taken.

The first three can be solved by checking based on the message's translation key instead of the message text itself.
(4) would require checking for incoming advancement toast pop ups or the advancement grant packet itself.

issues.title: [Request] option to require entity movement
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Eroding Stone Entities


## **Feature description**
Requiring item entities be moving for their timers to count down could be a nice way of making conversion contraptions slightly more complicated and interesting to engineer. 

As it is now, you can have a water source flow one block onto a hopper setup to sort for the output and that'd be the whole conversion contraption. If entity movement were required, you'd have to do something like make a loop, and you'd therefore have to ensure that items couldn't get caught in places like the inside of a hopper hitbox. 

Even better: a deeper take on this mechanic could also be requiring the item travel a certain distance to convert (implemented by decrementing a counter by the item's speed each tick, instead of simply by 1). This would give players a reason to build long, straight blue ice water streams, or maybe do some trickery with slime block pushing. The point is it opens up a way more possibilities for designs. 

[Also #712 would allow this to be per-'recipe', and players that don't want to mess with this sort of thing would never have to see it.]

issues.title: [Request] Make the mod data driven
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Eroding Stone Entities

## **Feature description**
Making the mod data driven (as in configured via datapacks, similar to recipes) would make the mod vastly more configurable. It would easily solve #479 and #433 and would make adding configurations for things like #409 easy. It would also make all configs per-'recipe' and sets of recipes peer-world, effectively adding new dimensions to the configureability.

issues.title: Sleep Sooner: Ability to change the list of "linger messages"
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Sleep Sooner
See: #497 

## **Feature description**
Currently, the list of "linger messages" are hardcoded into the Collective mod as follows:
https://github.com/ricksouth/serilum-mc-mods/blob/fe8bdd3369745984e2352c3f5487794efd789014/sources/Collective/src/main/java/com/natamus/collective/data/GlobalVariables.java#L52

For consistency with the implementation of #497, you could allow for Collective / Sleep Sooner to read a file, which contains a list of "linger messages" each separated by line breaks. Linger messages added to the list may appear in the following form:
> You [linger message] until dusk. You may now sleep.

For example, if the linger message "watch the ticks pass" is in the configured list, the following message may be displayed when Sleep Sooner is enabled:
> You watch the ticks pass until dusk. You may now sleep.

issues.title: Slight improvement suggestion for util.Util.java in TreeHarvester
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Tree Harvest


## **Feature description**
A minor code adjustment to your TreeHarvester mod could improve its compatibility with other mods. I've noticed in Environmental, the Wisteria Leaves block doesn't extend LeavesBlock. In TreeHarvester's util.Util.java class, the IsTreeLeaf() method could check if the block is in the tag minecraft:leaves instead of checking if it's an instance of LeavesBlock. A similar change could also be applied to the isTreeLog() method.

Particularly, line 86 reads
`if (block instanceof LeavesBlock || block instanceof BushBlock)`

It could instead read
`if (block.isIn(BlockTags.LEAVES) || block instanceof BushBlock)`

This would also make it possible to modify your mod's checks with datapacks, although I'm not sure how useful that would be lol.

issues.title: Consider releasing Fabric versions of Ricksouth's mods exclusively on Modrinth
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: (Any and all of Ricksouth's mods)

## **Feature description**
There are now two main websites that host Minecraft mods, that being Curseforge and [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/). There are also two major mod loaders: Forge and Fabric. Curseforge mainly hosted mods for Forge for a long time, while Modrinth currently hosts mainly Fabric mods.

Would it be possible to have the Fabric versions of Ricksouth's mods be available on Modrinth (instead of Curseforge)? For example, take the mod "Realistic Bees".
1. You port the mod to Fabric.
2. You release the mod exclusively on Modrinth.
3. You create a link on the Curseforge page suggesting to visit the Modrinth page to get the Fabric version for that mod.
4. You create the reverse link to step 3 (i.e. if you're on Modrinth and want the Forge version, visit the Curseforge page).
5. Repeat steps 3-4, but linking between https://minecraft.natamus.com (Forge version) and Modrinth (Fabric version).
6. You would then repeat steps 1-5 for every mod that you want a Fabric version of.

By doing this, you would effectively have two seperate profile pages for your mods, one for Forge and one for Fabric:
* The Forge version for the mods would be collected together and listed at https://www.curseforge.com/members/serilum/projects.
* The Fabric version for the mods would be collected together and listed at `https://modrinth.com/user/serilum` (or similar).

If implemented, this would likely resolve (most if not all of) the following: #585, #582, #558, #381, #380, #346, #316, #274, #272, #271, #265, #250, #219, and #183 (i.e. most of the issues returned in search results for term `fabric`, list may be incomplete)

issues.body:
The base mod is perfect for its use but you could add an optional setting to allow the clock to display the names of the times of the day.

For example, shown below is the estimated times of day in Minecraft

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65751519/119058782-a33e4e80-b994-11eb-9695-c3263754fb3b.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65751519/119058814-afc2a700-b994-11eb-9b1f-a7fe8151a45d.png)

All that would need to be added is a toggleable option to allow these names of the times of day to be shown with the time. This could be very beneficial to mods and mod packs that have set times when certain things can spawn. For example, Pixelmon with this mod could make finding certain ores like dawn/dusk ore easier and could make farming things like legendaries easier with knowing the times that they can spawn by chance.

issues.title: Idea: Golem tweaks
issues.body:
Mod idea: Golem tweaks (name is not necessarily final)

I've got a few ideas on how to make golems better you might be able to implement.

- Player-made iron golems spawn with pumpkins on their heads
- Pumpkins should be able to be placed back on after being sheared. Golems with pumpkins will follow you, while golems without will wander. Golems will stay stationary if given an undecided mid-game item (possibly nether quartz or glowstone)
- chance for snow golem to spawn naturally in a village in or near a cold biome (naturally spawned golems would not have pumpkin heads)
- snow golems apply potion effects to snowballs if inflicted, same way that creeper explosions leave area effect clouds if they have potion effects on them when they explode
- villagers (more specifically armorers and weaponsmiths due to their association with iron) will repair golems if they are low on health and there are no threats nearby
- repair snow golems with snowballs and snow blocks
- Give snow golems hot biome resistance, absorption and regeneration with blue or packed ice, making them harder to kill and more effective against undead mobs. issues.title: [Question, All Mods] Thoughts on someone forking to make a Fabric port?
issues.body:
Having read the FAQ, I think you have an excellent argument about a great deal of confusion being introduced from having Fabric ports on the same page. It really can be a bit tedious to sort that out in Curseforge's interface. (I do have plans to make a different interface that automates this somewhat to support packmakers, but that's a separate story.) And yes, it makes a great deal of sense that maintaining an additional hundred-some project pages would be substantially tedious.

Nonetheless, I still want there to be Fabric support (and think they'll perform even better there, due to Fabric's architecture handling large numbers of small mods better). However, given that you've shared the source code but have "All Rights Reserved" licenses in the mods, I can't just "fork and hope for the best" once I have the time, as I might with other projects. Don't want to step on any toes, infringe any copyrights, etc. 

So, what are your thoughts on the subject of a fork to port my favorites to Fabric? You make an enormous pile of very impressive mods, some of which I consider essential additions to an immersive pack. I'd love to get some friends together, make them available to a wider audience, and spread the love of awesome micro-mods.

issues.title: [Realistic Bees 1.16.5-1.2] Bees spawning as part of world gen will deadlock when realisticbees.events.BeeEvent.onBeeSpawn runs
issues.body:
This may be related to this issue report as well https://github.com/ricksouth/serilum-mc-mods/issues/470

Basically, if Realistic Bees is put on alongside my mod called The Bumblezone, entering my dimension always leads to the game hanging forever because my dimension spawns bees as part of world generation.
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-bumblezone-forge

I opened up VisualVM and did a thread dump to find out what caused the main thread to deadlock and it seems to be caused by `com.natamus.realisticbees.events.BeeEvent.onBeeSpawn(BeeEvent.java:74)` calling ServerWorld.func_217376_c (addEntity). 
https://paste.ee/p/hPMBE

Apparently, this occurring during world generation is unsafe and will deadlock the world. By doing addEntity from the ServerWorld while the chunk is being made, that method will call getChunk which deadlocks the game because getChunk will wait until the chunk is finished but we are calling that method while the chunk is still being made. Instead, try using world.spawnEntityAndPassengers as that method is safe to call during worldgen from a WorldGenRegion. The event should have the WorldGenRegion passed in instead of the ServerWorld. 

Hopefully this helps!

I love this idea, but I figured it could be a little op in some modpacks, and sometimes a grind can be relaxing for some folks. Adding a config to make it use durability for every second (10 seconds? idk) it is active, encouraging players to choose when and where they want to spend this durability.

issues.title: Expanding upon your campfire mods: Spawnpoint Campfires
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Campfire Spawnpoint. (I would call it home camp but a fabric mod that doesn't plan on porting already took that name.)


## **Feature description**
If you are out adventuring and want to set a sort of checkpoint in case you die (say, outside of a tough dungeon), you can shift right click a campfire to set it as your home camp, a secondary spawn point. When you die, you  will respawn at that campfire, but it will go out. Combining this with a mechanic make campfires start out unlit (Via a mod like campfire overhaul) could be really cool. Even better if you have some text above the hotbar that says "campfire lit" or something like that.

issues.title: Pets in other dimension (nether) will still show up on follower GUI
issues.body:
## **Information**
Minecraft version: 1.16.5
Forge version: 36.0.22
Environment: Singleplayer

Mod name: GUI Followers
Mod version: 1.2


## **Description**
So, I've downloaded another mod called Yung's Better Portals that changes how you get to and from the nether, and I also have quark which added foxhounds. I've tamed a foxhound while in the nether, but as of right now there is either a bug or it's simply not implemented where entities other than the player cannot be teleported out of the nether. (note that I only tested this while my foxhound was standing up, meaning I left the nether while it was standing and not sitting)

![2021-02-15_14 43 24](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43318292/107989059-63d02280-6f9f-11eb-9293-c5733260735e.png)

Now, this is where this mod comes in. After teleporting to the overworld without my pet foxhound, I noticed I could still see its GUI.
![2021-02-15_14 45 39](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43318292/107989106-7a767980-6f9f-11eb-82e6-a701278a0fa6.png)

Attempting to reach the position of my follower (in the overworld) as stated, led to me an area of open sky. Here you can see me on the ground (and jumping in the second image) to show there's nothing there.

![2021-02-15_14 46 14](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43318292/107989153-9bd76580-6f9f-11eb-8448-da7b522b7c88.png)
![2021-02-15_14 46 15](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43318292/107989156-9da12900-6f9f-11eb-99bf-b63dd7c6aba1.png)

I then went back to the nether and made my foxhound lay down, before teleporting back to the overworld. But then I noticed another bug! My foxhound GUI was still there! So I teleported back to the nether to check on my foxhound, and lo and behold the GUI was now on despite my foxhound laying down/sitting!
![2021-02-15_15 08 28](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43318292/107989291-fe306600-6f9f-11eb-9055-433557b60451.png)

I even tried having my foxhound stand up then sit again, to no avail.
![2021-02-15_15 11 11](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43318292/107989340-1902da80-6fa0-11eb-9436-f3287a4b6b71.png)
![2021-02-15_15 11 17](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43318292/107989342-1c966180-6fa0-11eb-9d3c-c335b55e1a0c.png)

Instead, it seems to have duplicated my foxhound GUI data. ... I just realized this may simply be a bug with Yung's Portals duplicating entity data... Uh. Well, I'll still submit this here just incase.

EDIT: Wait, that wouldn't make sense then, as the same GUI I have in the overworld also exists in the nether, regardless of my original foxhound...

## **Crash report**
No crashes

issues.title: End stone Version
issues.body:
there's been a few mods out there for a while now that let players create end portal frames to create their own end portals anywhere they wish. I think it would be really neat if we had a version of this very mod that would cause endstone to generate/replace the default blocks on the ground beneath and around such endportals - maybe even cause active endportals in strong holds to start converting the blocks and lava below them into endstone in a similar fashion to how netherack is generated near and around nether portals from the nether portal spread mod?

Just a neat thought to consider because of how this mod works!

## **Information**

issues.title: Better Bell Idea
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Better Bell

## **Feature description**
I'm currently working on a pack that includes Savage and Ravage as well as Dungeon Mobs (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/savage-and-ravage https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dungeons-mobs) and I noticed that the Bell ringing in Vanilla really sucks. It only works if there is a pillager within 32 blocks, only shows mobs in a 48 block radius, and only lasts for a few seconds. This turns the challenge of a raid from Fighting Mobs into instead Finding Mobs, some of which can be in caves, stuck, in lakes, ect. Here is my idea: A mod that improves upon these bells greatly. When the bell is rung by a player, all mobs part of the raid will have the glowing effect and particles until they die. This would make finding lost stragglers easy and allow you to get back to the fight as fast as possible.

## **Information**

I've had this amazing idea for a minimalist mod that I think really fits with the other mods you create. issues.title: "default" entry for nether portal spread
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Nether Portal Spread


## **Feature description**
Can we get a "default" replacement entry? e.g.:

default; [netherrack>5 + soul_sand>3 + magma_block>2],

If it's not defined, things behave as they do now. If it is defined, any brick it finds that isn't in the list with a specific entry uses this one.

This would save a whole lot of typing for those of us that want to have the spread hit basically everything.

This might create the need for a default exclusion list, to prevent some blocks from being changed, but I'm fine without that. Note, though, that at least the portal materials themselves, and probably the blocks being used as replacements, need to be immune, so it may be worth adding regardless.

## **Description**
The pending blocks tree / hashmap are getting out of sync.
The root cause was updating these lists from a different thread than minecraft with a call to set blocks based on scheduled ticks.   The list should only be modified in the main thread.

## **Information**

## **Feature description**
The Mojang API functions used to fetch player skins for use in Just Player Heads limits request rates such that you can't successfully request the same profile twice within 1 minute of each other. issues.title: Leaves not decaying
issues.body:
## **Information**
Minecraft version: 1.14.4
Forge version: 28.2.0
Environment: Singleplayer

Mod name: Tree Harvester
Mod version: treeharvester_1.14-1.2.jar


## **Description**
I just replaced these two:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fast-leaf-decay
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/falling-tree
With your tree harvester mod. 

I always had issues with the two other mods. Falling tree had no leaf decay when I used it which is why I added fast leaf decay. But fast leaf decay did not function with any large vanilla trees or any mod trees that were generated _with_ the world - it would only work on small vanilla trees and any trees I planted myself. So far your mod is better but I still have some leaf decay problems. 

1. If I break logs normally (by hand or non-crouching axe) the leaves remain and will never decay. 
2. If I break a small tree via the mod (with axe and crouching) it breaks completely whether it be one that naturally generated or one I planted (yay!). It even works on WildNature trees (also yay!). 
3. But large trees will often leave large sections of leaves that never decay. I am talking about trees such as the largest vanilla oak trees that can grow naturally. So about 3/4 of the leaves instantly break when I crouch-axe but 1/4 of them never decay. These leftover leaf chunks are usually the highest layer of the big tree so I have to build up to break those leaves. 

I can understand the leaves not breaking instantly if the upper layers were not close enough to the logs that were broken. However the leaves should still eventually decay over time. I have left some floating for several mc days and they persisted. So is the default leaf decay process is turned off when using this mod?  Or is there some setting I need to check? I see nothing in your config but maybe I need to check a setting on the vanilla side?

Please advise. Thank you!

FYI I made sure I delected the config files for the other two mods when I deleted the mods themselves.

NA

issues.title: Zombie/Skeleton Horsemen unable to move from initial spawnpoint
issues.body:
## **Information**
Minecraft version: 1.15.2
Forge version: 31.2.9
Environment: Singleplayer and Multiplayer

Mod name(s): Zombie Horse Spawn + Skeleton Horse Spawn + Collective
Mod version(s): 2.3, 1.2, 1.8


## **Description**
Whenever I notice a zombie riding a zombie horse or a skeleton riding a skeleton horse I find that they are able to look around when standing in the same spot but that they cannot move from the same spot after they have spawned in. If the horse dies or the rider dismounts then the rider is able to move again as normal and vice versa. 
![2020-06-11_15 53 28](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64381954/84403467-a4e88980-abfd-11ea-86a7-2c0dbd3ac2a8.png)
This is most noticeable with the zombies as they will raise their hands like in the screenshot above as if they are chasing something (which they are trying to do) but they are stuck to the spot and cannot move as long as they are mounted on the horse.
![2020-06-11_16 19 39](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64381954/84405017-79669e80-abff-11ea-8dbe-9e07b961535d.png)
When it happens with the skeletons they will still shoot at me but they will not strafe or try and avoid me like an unmounted skeleton would and they are unable to move, allowing me to just walk up and cut them down, after which the skeleton horse starts wandering around as normal. If the horse dies first then the skeleton starts strafing as normal.

It seems to me that for whatever reason the zombie or skeleton is unable to control the horse and because the mob on top always has control then the horse doesn't move and both mobs stay stuck where they initially spawned but that's just my best guess as to what is happening.

If you need any more information regarding this issue I would be happy to help!

issues.title: Sound Culling.
issues.body:
## **Information**
Mod name: Omega Mute


## **Feature description**
[Dynamic Surroundings: Sound Control](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dynamic-surroundings-soundcontrol) has a feature known as culling which allows you to set certain sounds to have a sort of 'cooldown' on them so they can only play so often.

(Example: I set ambient villager noises to be culled with a setting of 10 seconds. Now, no matter how many villagers are around me, the absolute most I can hear their ambient noises are once every ten seconds.)

I loved this feature in the Dynamic Surroundings version for 1.12; the 1.14 version never quite worked properly for me and it's not currently available for 1.15. Would love to have this ability again.

issues.title: Sided violation in right-click event handler for Sleep Sooner
issues.body:
## **Information**
Minecraft version: 1.14.4
Forge version: 28.2.3
Environment: Multiplayer

Mod name: Sleep Sooner
Mod version: 1.0


## **Description**
Block.getNameTextComponent is a purely client-side only thing. 

If you want to check if the block is a bed, I'd recommend using `block instanceof BlockBed` instead of relying on translation keys. For one, the information isn't available on the server, and secondly comparing against the translation *component* is liable to fail in other languages. 

I don't even need to decompile or look at your code to guess what you're doing simply based on looking up the function in MCP and, honestly, I feel like you're making more work for yourself just not straight-up checking `instanceof`.

If you want to be even faster you could place all beds in a static, pre-initialized set and then check for block membership of that set -- but that would fail with modded beds.

https://gist.github.com/noobanidus/53386e0eb82798db045b7878d702fbe3

issues.title: World Generation slowdown with Healing Campfire 1.7 (1.15.2)
issues.body:
## **Information**
Minecraft version: 1.15.2
Forge version: 31.1.0
Environment: Singleplayer

Mod name: Healing Campfire
Mod version: 1.7


## **Description**
Summary: Healing Campfire appears to extremely slow down world generation for Ultra Amplified mod version 7.3.0 (UA).

Details: When only UA mod is loaded, world generation takes 1-2 seconds. When Healing Campfire mod is added (and these are the only two mods), world generation takes 30+ seconds.

I'm trying to include this in a larger group of mods, but the performance decrease (in association with this mod and potentially other mods I'm looking at) causes world generation for mod dimensions to never complete (or at least take longer than an hour).

No crash, but log entries from latest.log (just showing the method - no additional info in debug log):

Hi there, love the mod. Have been using a combinations of your campfires and torches to spawn proof the main End island. Right after I completely spawn proofed the island, a heap of mobs all started spawning on the surface (which had been mob-free up until this point) all right next to campfires.
